problem: Find the average value of the function $f(x,y)=x+4{y}^{2}$ on the region $D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 3,\,0\le y\le \frac{x}{2}}$ given that the area of the region is $\frac{9}{4}.$

activity_context.topic_title: The Average Value of a Multivariable Function

feedback.problem: Find the average value of the function $f(x,y)={x}^{2}+3{y}^{2}$ on the region $D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 3,\,0\le y\le 1}.$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, notice that 

$$
\text{Area}(D)=1\cdot 3=3.
$$

Applying the average value formula, we find that the average value of the function is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{\text{ave}} & =\frac{1}{\text{Area}(D)}\,{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{∬}_{D}({x}^{2}+3{y}^{2})\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{\int }_{0}^{3}{\int }_{0}^{1}({x}^{2}+3{y}^{2})\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{\int }_{0}^{3}[{x}^{2}y+{y}^{3}]_{y=0}^{y=1}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{\int }_{0}^{3}({x}^{2}+1)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{3}[\frac{{x}^{3}}{3}+x]_{x=0}^{x=3} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}(\frac{{3}^{3}}{3}+3) \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$
